focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官，中国出口企业须完成首次数据申报
focus.summary: 欧盟CBAM过渡期于2026年底结束，进口商须在2027年1月31日前提交2026年第四季度报告。中国钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、氢和电力出口企业需配合欧盟客户提供嵌入排放数据，否则面临每吨未申报排放10-50欧元的罚款。建议企业立即核对产品CN代码、建立排放监测体系，并评估2027年起需购买CBAM证书的财务影响。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会税务与海关同盟总司 · 2026.11.27
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Ends: Chinese Exporters Must File First Data Report
focus.summary_en: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period concludes at the end of 2026, with importers required to submit their Q4 2026 reports by 31 January 2027. Chinese exporters of steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, hydrogen and electricity must provide embedded emissions data to EU clients or face penalties of €10–50 per tonne of unreported emissions. Companies should immediately verify product CN codes, establish emissions monitoring systems, and assess the financial impact of purchasing CBAM certificates from 2027.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission, DG Taxation and Customs Union · 2026.11.27

case.title: 新加坡上诉庭确立跨境在线仲裁条款效力认定标准，中企合同条款设计需调整
case.summary: 新加坡上诉法院近期在一宗涉华贸易纠纷中裁定，约定通过某国际仲裁机构在线平台仲裁的条款有效，即使该平台规则未明确仲裁地。法院强调，只要条款能合理确定仲裁程序与裁决终局性，即符合《纽约公约》要求。该判决提示中国出海企业：在跨境合同中应明确仲裁地、仲裁规则及裁决效力，避免使用模糊的“在线仲裁”表述，并优先选择《示范法》法域作为仲裁地。
case.title_en: Singapore Appellate Court Sets Test for Validity of Cross-Border Online Arbitration Clauses
case.summary_en: The Singapore Court of Appeal recently upheld an arbitration clause providing for arbitration via an international institution's online platform, even though the platform's rules did not specify a seat. The court stressed that a clause complies with the New York Convention if it reasonably determines the arbitral procedure and the finality of the award. This ruling reminds Chinese outbound businesses to expressly stipulate the seat, rules and finality of arbitration in cross-border contracts, avoid vague 'online arbitration' wording, and prefer Model Law jurisdictions as the seat.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore Court of Appeal · Nov 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化措施扩展至商贸领域，企业可申请“数据出境白名单”
policy.summary: 广东省网信办与港澳相关部门近期联合发布操作指引，将大湾区跨境数据流动便利化安排扩展至商贸、物流及专业服务领域。符合条件的企业可申请“数据出境白名单”，在特定场景下免于逐笔安全评估。建议企业梳理跨境数据流，评估是否符合白名单场景（如客户管理、供应链协同），并提前准备数据分类分级与合规审计材料，以享受政策红利。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.11
policy.title_en: GBA Cross-Border Data Flow Facilitation Extended to Trade and Commerce, 'Data Export Whitelist' Available
policy.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong, together with Hong Kong and Macao authorities, recently issued operational guidelines extending the Greater Bay Area's cross-border data flow facilitation arrangements to trade, logistics and professional services. Eligible companies may apply for a 'data export whitelist', exempting them from case-by-case security assessments in specified scenarios. Businesses should map their cross-border data flows, assess eligibility for whitelist scenarios (e.g., client management, supply chain coordination), and prepare data classification and compliance audit materials in advance to benefit from the policy.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · Nov 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美对华投资限制新规扩围，企业应建立“技术—股权—人员”三维合规筛查
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国近期将半导体、人工智能、量子计算领域的对华投资限制扩展至更多交易类型，并强化对“明知”标准的执法。中国出海企业及在华合资方应建立“技术—股权—人员”三维合规筛查机制：识别受限技术类别、穿透股权结构、审查美籍人员参与度，并在交易文件中加入合规陈述与保证条款。建议每季度更新筛查清单，对敏感交易提前申请豁免或调整交易架构。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师 · 律连全球 · 2026.11.27
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Expanded US Outbound Investment Restrictions on China Require a Three-Dimensional Compliance Screen
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The United States has recently expanded its outbound investment restrictions on China in semiconductors, artificial intelligence and quantum computing to more transaction types, while strengthening enforcement of the 'knowledge' standard. Chinese outbound companies and their Chinese JV partners should establish a three-dimensional compliance screen covering technology, equity and personnel: identify restricted technology categories, look through equity structures, review US-person involvement, and include compliance representations and warranties in transaction documents. Quarterly updates to the screening list are advised, with early exemption applications or deal restructuring for sensitive transactions.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao · iGlobal Law · 2026.11.27
